headline: Stray Kids' 'THIS & THAT' jumps 61 spots on Billboard 200
sub: Back at No. 79 in its 14th week, over 3 months after release
caption:
Stray Kids' 10th mini album 'THIS & THAT' climbs 61 spots to No. 79 on the Billboard 200 in its 14th week on the chart.

Released Aug 7, the album debuted at No. 1, the group's ninth chart-topper on the Billboard 200. On this week's charts it also returns to No. 4 on Top Album Sales and holds at No. 3 on World Albums, while Stray Kids rise 15 spots to No. 37 on the Artist 100.

📌 Source: Billboard (chart dated Nov 21)
